label: Screenshot
help: Pick an image to crop, or use the Screenshot button above the canvas if your browser supports screen capture.

label: Crop
help: Region of the shot to export, as a percentage. Drag on the canvas to set it.

label: Recording name
help: Filename for a saved screen recording.

label: System audio
help: Record the sound from the shared screen or tab. Whole-system sound works in Chrome on Windows and ChromeOS; elsewhere you may get only the tab's audio, or none at all.

label: Microphone
help: Also record your microphone so you can talk over the take.
